premises.text: Indoor growers' profits depend on controlling every growing condition
premises.evidence_span: being able to control those conditions means being able to control your profits

premises.text: Raw sensor and notebook data do not interoperate or guide decisions
premises.evidence_span: this is raw data. It doesn't talk to each other, and it doesn't tell Tom anything. It's virtually useless for Tom

premises.text: AgriList aggregates sensor sync, document upload, and manual entry in one place
premises.evidence_span: AgriList can automatically sync with any hardware he has in the equipment, like sensors. He can upload documents. And he can even enter data manually

premises.text: Dashboard, graphs, and task manager surface harvest/seed work and yield risks
premises.evidence_span: Agoralyst also acts as a task manager, showing Tom what he has to do on a day-to-day basis

premises.text: Recommendations on time-varying electricity rates cut lighting energy cost
premises.evidence_span: AgriList goes a step further and provides recommendations to show Tom when he should turn on and off his lights to achieve maximal savings

premises.text: Sold as subscription priced per acre per month to indoor/greenhouse growers
premises.evidence_span: Our private beta was released at a subscription price at $1,000 per acre per month

premises.text: Indoor hydroponic growth is expanding because it uses far less land and water
premises.evidence_span: more and more growers are moving indoors because of how efficient it is to grow hydroponically. It takes 10 times less land and 20 times less water to grow indoors hydroponically
